name: poweradmin/poweradmin
description: A web-based control panel for PowerDNS.

scripts-descriptions.docs:api: Print the OpenAPI spec as JSON; add -- --output <file> to write it
scripts-descriptions.docs:reference: Build the local class reference into docs/reference with Doctum
scripts-descriptions.lint:docblocks: Fail on @param tags that do not match the method signature (Doctum parse)
scripts-descriptions.sql:seed: Regenerate the seed INSERT blocks of sql/poweradmin-*-db-structure.sql from PermissionCatalogue; add -- --check to only verify

lint:docblocks:
out=$(php .doctum/doctum.phar parse doctum.php --force --no-progress -v 2>&1) || { printf '%s
' "$out" | grep '^ERROR'; echo 'ERROR: fix the docblocks above (composer lint:docblocks)'; exit 1; }
scripts.check:all: phpcs --standard=phpcs.xml addons bin bin/poweradmin config index.php install lib tests dynamic_update.php
scripts.format:all: phpcbf --standard=phpcs.xml addons bin bin/poweradmin config index.php install lib tests dynamic_update.php
scripts.analyse:phpstan: phpstan analyse --level=4 --memory-limit=512M addons bin bin/poweradmin config index.php install lib tests dynamic_update.php
scripts.analyse:complexity: phpstan analyse -c phpstan-complexity.neon --level=4 --memory-limit=512M addons config index.php install lib tests dynamic_update.php
lint:twig: ! grep -rn 'name="csrf_token"' templates/ lib/ --include='*.html' || (echo 'ERROR: Use name="_token" instead of name="csrf_token" for CSRF token fields' && false)
! grep -rn 'name="_token"' templates/ lib/ --include='*.html' | grep -v '_macros.html' || (echo 'ERROR: Use the csrf_field() macro from _macros.html instead of a raw _token input' && false)
scripts.lint:themes: failed=0; for f in $(cd templates/modern && find . -name '*.html' | sed 's|^\./||' | sort); do if ! grep -qx "$f" templates/theme-specific-templates.txt; then echo "Theme drift: templates/modern/$f is not listed in templates/theme-specific-templates.txt (identical templates live only in templates/default)"; failed=1; elif cmp -s "templates/default/$f" "templates/modern/$f"; then echo "Theme drift: $f is identical in both themes; delete the modern copy and its allowlist entry"; failed=1; fi; done; for f in $(grep -v '^#' templates/theme-specific-templates.txt); do [ -f "templates/modern/$f" ] || { echo "Theme drift: $f is allowlisted but missing from templates/modern"; failed=1; }; done; exit $failed
scripts.lint:no-traits: ! grep -rnE '^\s*trait ' lib/ --include='*.php' || (echo 'ERROR: lib/ does not use traits; share behaviour through a service or an abstract class instead (the installer keeps its five legacy ones)' && false)
scripts.lint:domain-imports: ! grep -rnE '^use (function |const )?\\?[A-Za-z0-9_]+\\' lib/Domain/ --include='*.php' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:use (function |const )?\\?(Poweradmin|Psr)\\' || (echo 'ERROR: lib/Domain must not import a third-party library. Put it behind a port in lib/Domain/Port with an adapter in lib/Infrastructure, the way TotpInterface and PublicSuffixInterface are wired. Psr interfaces are the only exception.' && false)
lint:permission-literals: ! grep -rnE "(hasPermission|userHasPermission|checkPermission|canPerformZoneAction|requirePermission|logAccessDenied)\([^)]*'(zone_master_add|zone_slave_add|zone_content_view_own|zone_content_edit_own|zone_meta_edit_own|zone_content_view_others|zone_content_edit_others|zone_meta_edit_others|search|supermaster_view|supermaster_add|supermaster_edit|user_is_ueberuser|user_view_others|user_add_new|user_edit_own|user_edit_others|user_passwd_edit_others|user_edit_templ_perm|templ_perm_add|templ_perm_edit|zone_content_edit_own_as_client|zone_templ_add|zone_templ_edit|api_manage_keys|zone_delete_own|zone_delete_others|user_enforce_mfa|zone_dnssec_manage_own|zone_logs_view_own|zone_logs_view_others|user_logs_view|group_logs_view|zone_content_edit_ns_subzone|zone_metadata_view_own|zone_metadata_view_others|zone_ownership_view_own|zone_ownership_view_others)'" lib/ --include='*.php' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*(\*|//)' || (echo 'ERROR: pass a Permission::PERM_* constant instead of a raw permission-name string literal, see lib/Domain/Model/Permission.php' && false)
lint:zone-ids: ! grep -rnE 'zg[0-9]*\.domain_id *(= *z[0-9_]*\.id\b|IN *\( *z[0-9_]*\.id)' lib/ || (echo 'ERROR: match zones_groups.domain_id against COALESCE(z.domain_id, z.id); zones.id and zones.domain_id overlap, see CanonicalZoneSql' && false)
lint:sensitive-params: ! grep -rnE '\??string \$(password|passwd|newPassword|oldPassword|user_password|plainPassword|currentPassword|paPass|pa_pass|dbPass|secret)\b' lib/ install/ --include='*.php' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*\*' | grep -v 'SensitiveParameter' || (echo 'ERROR: annotate the parameter above with #[\SensitiveParameter]; the attribute does not inherit, so every frame carrying a password needs its own' && false)
lint:error-traces: ! grep -rnE 'getTrace(AsString)?\(\)' lib/ install/ index.php dynamic_update.php --include='*.php' | grep -vE ':[0-9]+:[[:space:]]*\*' | grep -v 'BootstrapErrorResponder.php' || (echo 'ERROR: a stack trace prints call arguments, including passwords. Log the file and line instead of the trace. The only permitted traces live in BootstrapErrorResponder, gated behind misc.display_errors' && false)
scripts.locale:check: failed=0; for f in locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/messages.po; do if msgfmt --check -o /dev/null "$f" 2>&1 | grep -q 'fatal error'; then echo "FAIL: $f"; failed=1; fi; done; exit $failed
scripts.locale:msgfmt: failed=0; for f in locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/messages.po lib/Module/*/locale/*/messages.po; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if ! msgfmt --check -o /dev/null "$f" 2>/dev/null; then echo "FAIL: $f"; msgfmt --check -o /dev/null "$f" 2>&1 | grep -v 'warning:' | head -5; failed=1; fi; done; exit $failed
scripts.locale:mo-sync: failed=0; for f in locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/messages.po; do mo="${f%.po}.mo"; msgfmt -o /tmp/pa-mo-check.mo "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue; if ! cmp -s /tmp/pa-mo-check.mo "$mo"; then echo "STALE: $mo does not match $f"; failed=1; fi; done; rm -f /tmp/pa-mo-check.mo; exit $failed

ignore.GHSA-qrr6-mg7r-m243: phpunit is a dev-only dependency; 11.x line did not receive a back-port. Upgrading requires dropping PHP 8.2 support.
